“My name’s Belic. Not Sir—eight-day? You mean, a week? Well, if you don’t know—there are Ogres about! I’ve been trying to get back home south; I should have never come north, not with them about!”
Talia rode forwards. Belic turned to her, and she bowed.
He eyed Belic. The [Shoemaker] helpfully shrugged.
